---
title: "Study 2B: Computational modeling - fitting, comparison, parameters, PPC"
output: html_document
date: "2023-10-25"
---

This script fits and analyzes the hierarchical Bayesian models for Study 2B.
(The model/fit files use the "DJ_2b_rescale" prefix and were fitted to the
Study 2B data, i.e. the records with exp_name "dj_1a".)

Pipeline (model fits are cached: a model whose `<name>_hbm_3000.RData` already
exists in output/stanfits/ is NOT re-fitted):
  1. Build DJ_1a_data4stan.csv and fit the 8 candidate models.
  2. Model comparison (LOOIC).                          -> Figure S7A
  3. Best-fitting model (Model 1-4) parameter estimates. -> Figure 2C + paired t-tests
  4. Posterior predictive checks.                        -> Figure S7C, Figure S7B

Parameter recovery (Figure S7D) is produced by pm_recovery_2B.Rmd, which depends
on the PPC output (`..._Rating_pred_orig_mean.csv`) generated here.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

# 1. Prepare data for Stan

```{r prep4stan}
library(DescTools)

if (!file.exists(paste0(data_savedir, "DJ_1a_data4stan.csv"))) {
  df_valid <- read_csv(paste0(data_savedir, "DJ1_200_merge.csv")) %>%
    filter(type != "control") %>%
    filter(exp_name == "dj_1a") %>%          # dj_1a = Study 2B
    filter(participant != "NA") %>%
    rename(q1 = A_justice, q2 = B_empathy, q3 = C_justice, q4 = question4) %>%
    mutate(Delay_num   = delay,
           Delay_month = case_when(delay == 0 ~ 0, delay == 1 ~ 0.03,
                                   delay == 10 ~ 0.33, delay == 30 ~ 1,
                                   delay == 90 ~ 3, delay == 365 ~ 12),
           Delay_year  = case_when(delay == 0 ~ 0, delay == 1 ~ 0.003,
                                   delay == 10 ~ 0.027, delay == 30 ~ 0.08,
                                   delay == 90 ~ 0.25, delay == 365 ~ 1),
           type_idx = ifelse(type == "help", 0, 1),
           z.q4     = as.numeric(scale(q4)),
           q4_modi  = q4 / 100 + 0.5,
           eff_keep = numA + numB, eff_alter = changeA + changeB,
           s.eff_keep = eff_keep / 200, s.eff_alter = eff_alter / 200) %>%
    group_by(participant) %>% mutate(TrialNo_stan = 1:n()) %>% ungroup() %>%
    rowwise() %>% mutate(gini = Gini(c(numA, numB))) %>% as.data.frame()

  write.table(df_valid, paste0(data_savedir, "DJ_1a_data4stan.csv"),
              row.names = F, quote = F, sep = ",")
}

df <- read_csv(paste0(data_savedir, "DJ_1a_data4stan.csv"))
```

# 2. Fit the candidate models (cached)

```{r fit-models}
for (m in 1:modelno) {
  model_tmp <- paste0(models[m], "_hbm")
  fitname   <- paste0(models[m], "_hbm_", toString(nIter), ".RData")

  if (sum(stringr::str_detect(stanfitlist, fitname)) == 0) {
    print(paste0(model_tmp, " is now being fitted ..."))
    DJ_rstan_fit(modelStr = model_tmp, test = F, saveFit = T,
                 nIter = nIter, nwarmup = nwarmup,
                 data_dir = data_savedir, code_dir = code_savedir,
                 savedir = stanfit_savedir)
  } else {
    print(paste0(model_tmp, " has been fitted ..."))
  }
}
```

# 3. Model comparison (Figure S7A)

```{r rhat-fn}
rhat <- function(fit = NULL, less = NULL, paraidx = NULL) {
  if (class(fit$fit) != "stanfit") stop("'fit' is not of class stanfit!")
  summaryData <- rstan::summary(fit$fit)
  rhatData <- data.frame(Rhat = summaryData[["summary"]][, "Rhat"])
  if (!is.null(less)) {
    rhat_IsValid <- as.numeric(all(rhatData$Rhat[1:paraidx] <= less))
    list(rhat_IsValid = rhat_IsValid, rhat_max = max(rhatData$Rhat[1:paraidx]))
  } else {
    rhatData
  }
}
```

```{r model-comparison-wrapper}
model_comparison_wrapper <- function(model_label, rstan_dir, N_iter, df_input,
                                     savedir = stanfit_savedir, IsSave = 1) {
  modelno <- length(model_label)
  rhat_IsValid <- rhat_max <- myloo <- mywaic <- array(0, c(modelno))

  for (m in 1:modelno) {
    sbjno   <- length(unique(df_input))
    fitname <- paste0(rstan_dir, model_label[m], "_hbm_", N_iter, ".RData")
    fit <- readRDS(fitname)
    fit$fit@.MISC <- new.env(parent = globalenv())
    pois_tmp     <- create_pois(paste0(model_label[m], "_hbm"))
    N_group_pars <- sum(stringr::str_detect(pois_tmp, "mu_"))
    paraidx      <- (N_group_pars / 2) * sbjno + N_group_pars
    rhat_output  <- rhat(fit = fit, less = 1.1, paraidx = paraidx)
    rhat_IsValid[[m]] <- rhat_output[[1]]
    rhat_max[[m]]     <- rhat_output[[2]]
    mylog_lik   <- loo::extract_log_lik(fit$fit, parameter_name = "log_lik")
    myloo[[m]]  <- loo::loo(mylog_lik)$looic
    mywaic[[m]] <- loo::waic(mylog_lik)$waic
  }

  df_mc <- data.frame(model = model_label, rhat_IsValid = rhat_IsValid,
                      rhat_max = rhat_max, looic = as.numeric(myloo),
                      waic = as.numeric(mywaic))
  if (IsSave == 1) {
    write.table(df_mc, paste0(savedir, "modelcomparison_2b.csv"),
                row.names = F, quote = F, sep = ",")
  }
  df_mc
}
```

```{r run-model-comparison}
if (file.exists(paste0(stanfit_savedir, "modelcomparison_2b.csv"))) {
  df_mc <- read.table(paste0(stanfit_savedir, "modelcomparison_2b.csv"),
                      header = T, sep = ",")
} else {
  df_mc <- model_comparison_wrapper(model_label = models,
                                    rstan_dir = stanfit_savedir,
                                    df_input = df, N_iter = nIter, IsSave = 1)
}
df_mc <- df_mc %>% filter(model %in% models)
print(df_mc)
```

```{r figure-S7A}
# Delta model evidence relative to the worst-fitting model; Model 1-4 is best
# (delta LOOIC approximately -1125).
mc_plot <- df_mc %>%
  mutate(Model = paste0(" Model ", sub("DJ_2b_rescale_m", "", model)),
         delta = looic - max(looic),
         is_best = model == "DJ_2b_rescale_m1-4")

ggplot(mc_plot, aes(x = reorder(Model, looic), y = delta)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.55, color = "black", linewidth = 0.4,
           alpha = 0.7, fill = "lightgrey") +
  geom_bar(data = subset(mc_plot, is_best), stat = "identity",
           width = 0.55, color = "black", linewidth = 1.8, fill = NA) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(delta)), hjust = -0.1, size = 5) +
  labs(title = "Model Comparison", x = "Model",
       y = "Δlog Model Evidence (LOOIC)") +
  coord_flip(ylim = c(-1250, 0)) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme_minimal() + myconfig +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.line.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 1, margin = margin(r = 0)))

ggsave(paste0(plot_savedir, "FigureS7A.png"),
       width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```

# 4. Best-fitting model (Model 1-4) parameters

```{r winning-model}
m_win    <- 4
winmodel <- models[m_win]
fitname  <- paste0(stanfit_savedir, winmodel, "_hbm_3000.RData")

pars_win     <- create_pois(paste0(winmodel, "_hbm"))
N_group_pars <- sum(stringr::str_detect(pars_win, "mu_"))
ind_pars     <- pars_win[1:(length(pars_win) - 4 - N_group_pars)]

indpm_file    <- paste0(stanfit_savedir, "winmodel_", winmodel, "_indpm.csv")
ppc_mean_file <- paste0(stanfit_savedir, winmodel, "_Rating_pred_orig_mean.csv")

# The 1.16 GB fitted object is loaded ONLY if the cached parameter / prediction
# files are missing; otherwise the cached CSVs below are used directly.
if (!file.exists(indpm_file) || !file.exists(ppc_mean_file)) {
  fit <- readRDS(fitname)
}
```

```{r extract-individual-params}
get_pm_individual <- function(df_input, pars_input, df_input1, N_Chains) {
  Sbj_label <- unique(df_input1$participant)
  pars_value_all <- get_posterior_mean(df_input$fit, pars = pars_input)[, N_Chains + 1]
  data.frame(pars_value = pars_value_all,
             pars_name  = rep(pars_input, each = length(Sbj_label)),
             SbjIdx     = rep(Sbj_label, times = length(pars_input)))
}

if (!file.exists(indpm_file)) {
  df_idx <- df %>% group_by(TrialNo_stan) %>% mutate(SbjIdx = 1:n()) %>% ungroup()
  df_pm_individual <- get_pm_individual(fit, ind_pars, df_idx, nChains)
  write.table(df_pm_individual, indpm_file, row.names = F, quote = F, sep = ",")
}

df_pm_individual <- read.csv(indpm_file)
parameter_gamma <- df_pm_individual %>% filter(pars_name %in% c("gamma_help", "gamma_punish"))
parameter_k     <- df_pm_individual %>% filter(pars_name %in% c("k_help", "k_punish"))
```

```{r param-ttests}
# Compensation (help) vs punishment (punish), paired t-tests
g_wide <- parameter_gamma %>% pivot_wider(names_from = pars_name, values_from = pars_value)
k_wide <- parameter_k     %>% pivot_wider(names_from = pars_name, values_from = pars_value)

t.test(g_wide$gamma_help, g_wide$gamma_punish, paired = TRUE)   # Figure 2C: gamma_C vs gamma_P
t.test(k_wide$k_help,     k_wide$k_punish,     paired = TRUE)   # Figure 2C: kappa_C vs kappa_P
```

```{r figure-2C-helper}
plot_param_violin <- function(d, ylim, ybreaks, xlab, outfile) {
  lvls <- sort(unique(d$pars_name))          # *_help (compensation), *_punish (punishment)
  tt   <- t.test(d$pars_value[d$pars_name == lvls[1]],
                 d$pars_value[d$pars_name == lvls[2]], paired = TRUE)
  sig  <- ifelse(tt$p.value <= .001, "***",
          ifelse(tt$p.value <= .01, "**",
          ifelse(tt$p.value <= .05, "*", "ns")))
  ytop <- max(d$pars_value)

  ggplot(d, aes(x = pars_name, y = pars_value, fill = pars_name, color = pars_name)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
    geom_quasirandom(shape = 16, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.4, width = 0.2) +
    geom_line(aes(group = SbjIdx), color = "grey70", alpha = 0.4) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.4, color = "black", size = 0.2) +
    stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.15, color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = ytop + 0.09, label = sig, size = 6) +
    geom_segment(x = 1, xend = 2, y = ytop + 0.07, yend = ytop + 0.07, color = "black") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = ylim, breaks = ybreaks) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey88", "grey88")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#5B8DB8", "#C06060")) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Compensation", "Punishment")) +
    labs(title = " ", x = xlab, y = "Parameter Value") +
    theme_minimal() + myconfig +
    theme(legend.position = "none", axis.line.x = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.8, color = "black"),
          axis.ticks.length = unit(0.2, "cm"),
          axis.text   = element_text(size = 15),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, vjust = -1, face = "bold"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, vjust = 1,  face = "bold"),
          axis.text.x = element_text(color = c("#5B8DB8", "#C06060"), size = 15))

  ggsave(paste0(plot_savedir, outfile), width = 4.5, height = 4)
}
```

```{r figure-2C}
plot_param_violin(parameter_gamma, ylim = c(-0.8, 1.0), ybreaks = seq(-0.8, 1.0, 0.3),
                  xlab = "Inequity Aversion (γ)", outfile = "Figure2C_gamma.png")
plot_param_violin(parameter_k, ylim = c(-0.05, 0.6), ybreaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.1),
```

# 5. Posterior predictive checks (Figure S7C, Figure S7B)

```{r ppc-trial-means}
y_label <- if (stringr::str_detect(winmodel, "rescale")) "q4_modi" else "q4"

if (!file.exists(ppc_mean_file)) {
  # Extract trial-level predicted ratings from the fitted object (only when the
  # cached file is absent).
  df_idx <- df %>% group_by(TrialNo_stan) %>% mutate(SbjIdx = 1:n()) %>% ungroup()
  Rating_pred_orig <- as.data.frame(rstan::extract(fit$fit, pars = "Rating_pred", permuted = F))
  col_names <- as.data.frame(colnames(Rating_pred_orig))

  Rating_pred_orig_byChain <- t(Rating_pred_orig) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    rowwise() %>% mutate(pred_mean = mean(c_across(1:1000))) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::select(1001) %>% cbind(col_names) %>% dplyr::rename(Rowname_orig = 2) %>%
    mutate(ChainIdx = as.numeric(str_sub(Rowname_orig, 7, 7)),
           SbjIdx_orig = str_sub(Rowname_orig, 21, nchar(Rowname_orig) - 3),
           TrialNo_stan_orig = str_sub(Rowname_orig, nchar(Rowname_orig) - 2, nchar(Rowname_orig) - 1)) %>%
    mutate(SbjIdx = as.numeric(ifelse(str_detect(SbjIdx_orig, ","),
                  str_sub(SbjIdx_orig, 1, nchar(SbjIdx_orig) - 1), SbjIdx_orig)),
           TrialNo_stan = as.numeric(ifelse(str_detect(TrialNo_stan_orig, ","),
                  str_sub(TrialNo_stan_orig, 2, nchar(TrialNo_stan_orig)), TrialNo_stan_orig))) %>%
    dplyr::select(-SbjIdx_orig, -TrialNo_stan_orig, -Rowname_orig)

  Rating_pred_orig_mean <- Rating_pred_orig_byChain %>%
    spread(ChainIdx, pred_mean) %>% rowwise() %>%
    mutate(pred_mean = mean(c_across(3:6))) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::select(SbjIdx, TrialNo_stan, pred_mean) %>%
    merge(df_idx, by = c("SbjIdx", "TrialNo_stan")) %>% arrange(SbjIdx, TrialNo_stan)

  write.table(Rating_pred_orig_mean, ppc_mean_file, row.names = F, quote = F, sep = ",")
}

Rating_pred_orig_mean <- read.table(ppc_mean_file, header = T, sep = ",")
```

```{r ppc-correlations}
# Per-subject mean predicted vs observed, by condition; correlation per type
pred_persbj <- Rating_pred_orig_mean %>%
  group_by(participant, type) %>%
  summarise(pred = mean(pred_mean), obs = mean(.data[[y_label]]), .groups = "drop")

pred_persbj %>% group_by(type) %>%
  summarise(corr = cor(pred, obs, use = "complete.obs"))   # Figure S7C: rs > 0.97
```

```{r figure-S7C}
ggplot(pred_persbj, aes(x = obs, y = pred, color = type)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = .8) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, size = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(name = "", values = c("#5B8DB8", "#C06060"),
                     labels = c("Compensation", "Punishment")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +

  theme_bw() + myconfig +
  theme(axis.text    = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),

        aspect.ratio = 1)

ggsave(paste0(plot_savedir, "FigureS7C.png"), width = 5.6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r figure-S7B}
# Model-predicted vs observed justice ratings across delay (original -50..50 scale)
type_labels <- c("help" = "Compensation", "punish" = "Punishment")
df_delay <- Rating_pred_orig_mean %>%
  mutate(Actual = q4, Predicted = (pred_mean - 0.5) * 100) %>%
  group_by(participant, delay, type) %>%
  summarise(obs = mean(Actual), pred = mean(Predicted), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(delay, type) %>%
  summarise(obs_mean = mean(obs), obs_se = sd(obs) / sqrt(n()),
            pred_mean = mean(pred), .groups = "drop")

# Compensation = blue, punishment = red (matching the parameter figures); within
# each panel, observed = hollow points (+/- SEM) and predicted = solid line.
type_cols <- c("help" = "#5B8DB8", "punish" = "#C06060")

ggplot(df_delay, aes(x = delay, color = type)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(y = obs_mean, ymin = obs_mean - obs_se, ymax = obs_mean + obs_se),
                width = 10, size = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(y = obs_mean, shape = "Observed"), fill = "white", size = 3, stroke = 0.9) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pred_mean, linetype = "Predicted"), size = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free", labeller = labeller(type = type_labels)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = type_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "", values = c("Observed" = 21)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(name = "", values = c("Predicted" = "solid")) +
  labs(x = "Temporal Delay (day)", y = "Justice Rating") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 30, 90, 365)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 40)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 40, 10)) +
  theme_minimal() + myconfig +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(2, "cm"), legend.position = "top")

ggsave(paste0(plot_savedir, "FigureS7B.png"), width = 8, height = 4)
```
